headline: ICBC, ABC, BOC, CCB, Bank of Communications, Postal Savings Bank and others issue joint notice
summary: Major Chinese banks, including Agricultural Bank of China and China Construction Bank, said no fiscal interest subsidies will be granted for credit card fraud, false consumption or illegal fund flows. Overdue repayments are also covered.
why: The big state-owned banks are among the largest lenders in China, and their card and subsidy rules affect consumer credit and bank revenue. Enforcement shifts can change lending volumes and fee income.
